title: Nyghtshade Hollow - Four Hours (dialogue movie cut)
source: Nyghtshade_Hollow_Dialogue.pdf (current-canon sourcebook, Oct 2 2026). Lines are verbatim; scenes abridged for a ~5 minute cut.

scenes.title: Back Under the Baptismal
scenes.place: chapel, under the baptismal font, night
lines: Darkness under the baptismal. Voices above fade. The pulpit rotates back.
How many times you done that alone?
Past the tree line there is a clearing. Old oak, four feet through. Got a crate. A blanket, a couple books, little food.
Be nice if tomorrow you came with me. Service ends early. Count is at nine-thirty. That is near four hours.
Four hours. Not five minutes. What do you even do with that?
Sit. Listen. Read. Feel grass through your socks. Hear a car go by where no one is counting you.
That is a dangerous amount of freedom.
Because five minutes feels like mercy. Four hours feels like your life is yours again.
Maybe nothing. For men like us, maybe that is everything.

scenes.title: Rules for Four Hours
lines: Then we plan it the same way you plan a yard. Boundaries. No crowds. No lights. No open street.
Four hours of pretending I am not a ghost.
Four hours of remembering you are not one.
You keep your word. You come back. Every time.

scenes.title: The Call to Allen
lines: A cell at night. A contraband phone lights a tattooed hand.
Justin's bike. I need you to deliver it somewhere.
No way, man. That is the only thing we got left of Justin.
You sound like you are saying goodbye.
No. No goodbyes. Just do this quiet. No questions. No names. Drop it and walk away.
Yeah. Okay. For Justin. For you.

scenes.title: One Last Ride
scenes.place: outside the tunnel mouth, then the road
lines: One last ride, brother. One last ride.
I am not riding with you on that death trap.
Yes, you are. One more time. Let the wind go through your hair.
Then the wind will have less to fight.
The engine wakes. Two men on an empty road beyond the prison.
You said you wanted to feel alive!
I said I wanted air, not judgment day!

scenes.title: The Underground Home
lines: Storage once. Now it is nothing.
Weeks later. Lights, a bed, shelves of books, the motorcycle against the wall.
Somebody has to make sure you do not turn a tunnel into a subdivision.

scenes.title: Mama's Dinner
lines: Funny thing about getting old, son. Last night I dreamed about a plate.
Steak. Potatoes. Gravy. Mama used to put too much pepper in the gravy. I would give damn near anything to complain about that gravy one more time.
A hot pan. Butter hisses. Three plates.
I have not had that meal in fifty-three years. I forgot what it tasted like.
I thought I was getting too old to carry things. Turns out, I was too old to carry everything.
You are a good man, son.
Some days I do not feel like one.
Good. That is how you know you are still trying.

scenes.title: Sunday
lines: Because this place becomes a tunnel again.
Then next Friday we make it a home again.
